messages:
emily: Quick follow-up on the postmortem (missing spans + aggregation drift). Need owners + dates for remediations. Can we use this thread to track status?

jia: I can take the ETL bug that caused dropped spans. Root cause was the time-window join mismatch on event_time -> losing late-arriving spans. Plan: patch + backfill. ETA ~72h.

samir: I'll own the aggregator alignment fix. Plan: canary deploy tomorrow 10:00am, monitor for 6h, then full rollout if stable.

matt: I can provision GPUs for the backfill. Jia, can you post a quick count query so I can size the job?

jia: Count query to estimate affected rows: 
```
SELECT count(*) FROM events_raw WHERE event_time BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-07' AND span_id IS NULL;
```
Expected ~12M rows. Backfill would need ~4x A100-equivalent GPUs for ~9 hours if we parallelize.

emily: OK, assigning owners here: jia = ETL patch + backfill (due +3d), samir = aggregator fix + canary (due +1d), matt = compute provisioning & cost signoff (due 24h). I'll add these to the remediation tracker and send calendar invites.

samir: Also adding a regression test to the aggregator repo to catch the window-edge overlap. Unit + integration test.

jia: Opening PR for ETL change now: https://github.com/redwood/etl/pull/342 :eyes: CI running.

ops-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-143 -> https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-143

matt: Quick cost note: estimated $120 for backfill compute (short-lived). Marking budget approved.

emily: Thanks. Can each owner ping here when PR merged / canary started / backfill complete? I'll do a 48h check-in. :thumbsup: 

samir: Will ping when canary starts.

jia: PR opened and CI green, requesting review from @samir.

samir: Reviewing now — left a small comment about the window boundary handling.

jia: Fixed and pushed. Merging now. Backfill scheduled to start at 2287730000 (epoch).

emily: Got it. I'll update the remediation board with the schedule + owners. Closing the loop after backfill finishes and we validate span coverage in dashboards. Thanks all.
